test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 04
subject: general
question: Choose the one which is odd from the following options.
solution:
• In the given option except for **rice**, all are plantation crops. While Rice is a Khariff crop.
 
• Plantation crops constitute a large group of crops. The major plantation crops include coconut, areca nut, oil palm, cashew, tea, coffee, Tobacco, Sugarcane and rubber; the minor plantation crops include cocoa.
 
• Their total coverage is comparatively less and they are mostly confined to smallholdings.
